scope: Non-test TypeScript variable declarations under packages/operator-core/lib that instantiate Map and whose locally resolvable value type explicitly declares an expiry field.
method: Parse TypeScript syntax trees; resolve inline and same-file interface/type declarations; select expiresAt, expiresMs, expires, expiry, expireAt, expiryMs or validUntil properties; read each candidate's producer and consumer to distinguish cached reads from temporary expiry-bearing collections.

confirmed.evidence: cachedHasRemotePeer returns cached.value while cached.expiresAt > now, otherwise resolves authority and writes value plus now + ttlMs.
createOmpModelCatalogReader returns cached.value while expiresAt > now(), shares pending reads, and writes parsed catalog plus now() + ttlMs.
keychainLoad returns a cloned cached result while hit.expiresAt > Date.now(); successful and not-found reads write different explicit TTLs.
getMemberDeviceSet returns hit.set while expiresAt > now(), otherwise loads members and writes now() + MEMBER_SET_TTL_MS.
readGitLog returns cached.commits when headSig matches and cached.expires > now, otherwise runs git and stores now + ttlMs.

excluded.reason: Per-call grouping of persisted provenance stamps; expiry belongs to stamp validity, not cached reads.
Per-call result map of condition objects.
Per-call coupling-edge lookup used while resolving peers.
Per-round index of peer locks; expiry is a lock lease.

limitations: The count is limited to this explicit-type declaration population. It is not the total number of TTL caches across the repository.
Numeric deadlines, inferred types, imported value types, class fields and nested cache abstractions are outside this syntax query.
The earlier text scan's candidate count is not a confirmed cache count.
